H3b.bias_fraction: sum n_type*||mean_token(delta)||^2 / sum ||delta||^2; per layer,type,K/V and joint, pooled over256 training observations
H3b.means: Computed per observation for H3b; calibration-wide means ONLY for H5d
H3b.permutation: ii-c preserves receiving token joint K/V norm within each layer; padding untouched
H3b.random_sign: ii-b independent token Rademacher signs, shared between K/V and ALL layers
H3b.layer_permutation: Original iii retained as additional structural control
H3b.predictions: Unit and half, and mean-only, reproduce gain8/loss9; residual,random-sign,permutations do not; negative removes/reverses
H3b.validation: 256 exact zero vsFP and256 exact unit vsH1c; independent RNG; paired identities; nativeBF16 persistent donors

rules.stalled_holding: After first target grasp, target grasped at window start and non-opening gripper commands throughout; first50step window cup AND eef diameter <=threshold and door notclosed; goal predicate unchanged
rules.cup_in_door_open: After target release and cup containment, first50step window eef diameter <=threshold, door angle range <=0.001radian and door notclosed

H4b.observation: Saved policy-query images and saved simulator state at window start. State features derived by forward kinematics of saved state; no action replay and no re-rendering. Mark unavailable if not recoverable.
H4b.sampling: Search only saved policy-query starts on5step grid; all50 control states check window; no nearest-frame substitution
H4b.controls: All successful FP and uniformM2 task9 episodes: first saved observation inside microwave-opening region; undetected reported
H4b.opening_region: Heating-region box expanded5cm only toward front opening; cup centre in local axes; fixed before latent probes
H4b.release: Any first5 physical gripper commands <0; report per-step rates, episode fractions, initial-state-clustered paired CIs
H4b.cohort_caveat: 15 historical other cases are candidates, not15 proven cup-in failures;8 have final containment

Plus_J.selection: First100 pre-registered entries per dimension in existing manifest order
Plus_J.match: Same original base task, state0, settle10, same latent; disclose repeated base observations
Plus_J.jacobian: Exact70x70 J_D,9=I-0.1*dv9/dx on10x7 action coordinates; FP32 expert, nativeBF16 prefix widened; TF32 disabled; trace/70
Plus_J.interpretation: Trace diagnostic is not a calibrated posterior variance estimate

H5d.training: 256 observations from existing60 training episodes only
H5d.bias: Mean deltaK/V perlayer/type across valid calibration tokens
H5d.apply: Subtract FP32 means from quantized cachedKV afterRoPE, cast nativeBF16 once; uniformM2expert frozen
H5d.gate: H3b all4500 validated AND H4 all requested failures reviewed before ANY H5 evaluation; fitting allowed

preregistration.H2: Retain per-model appendix table as diagnostic evidence only; failed detector gate remains recorded

H4b.release_definition: Any gripper command<0 in first5 executed steps; no actions executed
